identity.title: Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station (PVNGS) Unit 3

cause.proximate_text: The direct cause of the event was lack of formality and adequate details in the verbal communications between the Operations and Chemistry departments. The Operations Department and Chemistry Department communications for the LCO required boron samples did not specify all requirements. The apparent cause is that the Chemistry Department procedure did not contain specific sampling requirements necessary to satisfy the required actions of LCO 3.3.12 Condition B.
cause.theme: Inadequate procedure guidance / communication between departments

chain: inadequate Chemistry procedure & incomplete Ops-Chemistry communication [cause TBD] -> boron samples taken from wrong sample point / not obtained redundantly -> LCO 3.3.12 Condition B required actions not satisfied; separately, alternate power maintenance while normal power inoperable -> unanticipated annunciator power loss -> both BDAS channels declared inoperable -> TS LCO 3.3.12 Conditions A and B entered/not met
notes: This event actually comprises two related but distinct failure threads under one LCO violation: (1) a power-supply maintenance issue causing annunciator/BDAS inoperability (resolved same day, 1100-1233), and (2) a sampling/communication deficiency discovered days later (4/13) that revealed the boron samples taken to satisfy LCO 3.3.12 Condition B were improperly obtained. The official cause code is TBD/provisional per FORM-366 fields, despite narrative providing direct/apparent cause language; category kept as 'provisional' per rule 4. No block_13 data provided in FORM-366 fields (empty array), so none synthesized. No manufacturer, previous similar event, or backup system information stated in narrative (Section 8 blank) -> no SIMILAR_TO edge or stub LER created, no BACKED_UP_BY edges asserted since no operable backup system is named for BDAS during the inoperability window.
